_comment: Places the milestone-0 picture sheet marks on the Texas 1846 map (brief of 2026-11-09, order of work, step 0). Coordinates are Wikidata's (P625, CC0), read from the API on 2026-11-09 by hand-checked id; nothing is typed from a map. These are NOT records: the sheet is a mock-up of proposals P1–P10, and every mark on it is an illustration of a form, dated and named from the sources in 'note'. Real rows go through the owner and the teachers (data/military.csv, milestone 1 on).

fort-texas.label: Fort Texas
fort-texas.note: Wikidata: Fort Brown; named Fort Texas until 17 May 1846

port-isabel.label: Point Isabel
port-isabel.note: Taylor's supply depot from 24 March 1846 (Bauer 1974); Wikidata: Port Isabel, Texas

brazos-santiago.label: Brazos Santiago
brazos-santiago.note: the pass into the Laguna Madre, the landing for Point Isabel

monterrey.label: Monterrey
monterrey.note: capital of Nuevo León; taken 24 September 1846

santa-fe.label: Santa Fe
santa-fe.note: capital of New Mexico; entered by Kearny 18 August 1846

veracruz.label: Veracruz
veracruz.note: outside the Texas frame: used only for a 'to Veracruz' tab

thornton-affair.label: Thornton Affair
thornton-affair.note: Wikidata's point for the skirmish at Rancho de Carricitos

buena-vista.label: Buena Vista
buena-vista.note: La Angostura in Mexican sources; both sides claimed the victory
